title: MUSCLE MANGA - Rihito 'The Ripper' Physique in Kengan Ashura
summary: First Kengan Ashura episode of Muscle Manga, comparing Rihito 'The Ripper' with Grappler Baki's Shinogi Kosho. Both turn their fingers into blades, but Rihito relies on innate grip strength and brute size while Kosho earned his technique through years of training. NH uses them to discuss talent versus skill.
claims: Martial arts manga ask whether a human can become a weapon rather than merely beat armed opponents
Rihito was born with superhuman pinch grip and put zero effort into his flesh-shaving technique, while Kosho trained painfully for years to turn his fingers into blades
Rihito is listed at 6'2 and 225 lb, while the technical Kosho is 5'8 and 180 lb with a more refined physique
Wide slashing swings are like haymakers: devastating when they land but telegraphed and easy to predict
Rihito never developed beyond his natural talent because it was enough against ordinary fighters, until a genius like Ohma exposed him
Talent alone fails against skilled opponents; Rihito has to learn he needs technique, not just strength
